newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey assesses sugar export tender bids.
newsitem.headline: Turkey assesses sugar export tender bids.

text.p: Turkish state sugar refiner Turkseker said on Tuesday it was assessing bids from several companies for a tender under which it will sell up to 50,000 tonnes of white sugar.
A Turkseker official said up to 10 firms had submitted bids to buy the sugar but did not identify them.
"I think the evaluation of the tender bids will be completed by tomorrow afternoon," said the official.
Traders said the tender received limited interest from many local and international trade companies because of the terms.

Turkseker required that the sugar be delivered to the buyer by road from several refineries at various locations in Turkey. The buyers should also give a letter of guarantee equal to the value of their purchase.
Traders said they expected the sugar to be delivered from the refineries at Elbistan, Agri, Kars, Bor and Carsamba.
